create_dp_round_reducer: create a DPRoundReducer instance with a global model, users per round, and total users for DP federated learning
update_reduced_module_with_clipping: update the reduced module by clipping the delta module with the user update clipper before aggregation
reduce_with_dp_noise: reduce client updates by summing weights, adding calibrated noise, and broadcasting the noisy model to all workers
get_privacy_budget: get the current privacy budget spent by the DP round reducer after aggregation rounds
reset_dp_round_reducer: reset the DP round reducer with a new reference model and reattach the privacy engine
